js: (async()=>{const st=await (await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8896/api/interactive/boards/board_default/state')).json();const live=st.state.cards.filter(c=>!c.deleted&&c.kind!=='reply');const src=live[live.length-1],dst=live[0];const el=document.querySelector('[data-card-id="'+src.id+'"]');const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();const x=r.x+r.width/2,y=r.y+12;el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',{bubbles:true,clientX:x,clientY:y,pointerId:21,buttons:1}));window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup',{bubbles:true,clientX:x,clientY:y,pointerId:21}));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600));const right=[...document.querySelectorAll("[data-im=\"connect-point\"]")].find(p=>p.getAttribute('data-side')==='right');const rb=right.getBoundingClientRect();const px=rb.left+rb.width/2,py=rb.top+rb.height/2;const target=document.querySelector('[data-card-id="'+dst.id+'"]');const tb=target.getBoundingClientRect();const tx=tb.left+tb.width/2,ty=tb.top+tb.height/2;const before=(await (await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8896/api/interactive/boards/board_default/state')).json()).state.links.length;right.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',{bubbles:true,clientX:px,clientY:py,pointerId:22,buttons:1}));for(let i=1;i<=8;i++){window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove',{bubbles:true,clientX:px+(tx-px)*i/8,clientY:py+(ty-py)*i/8,pointerId:22,buttons:1}))}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400));const draftVisible=!!document.querySelector("[data-im=\"link-draft\"]");window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup',{bubbles:true,clientX:tx,clientY:ty,pointerId:22}));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1800));const after=(await (await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8896/api/interactive/boards/board_default/state')).json()).state;return JSON.stringify({src:src.id,dst:dst.id,linksBefore:before,linksAfter:after.links.length,newLink:after.links[after.links.length-1]||null,draftVisibleDuringDrag:draftVisible})})()

(async()=>{const st=await (await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8896/api/interactive/boards/board_default/state')).json();const live=st.state.cards.filter(c=>!c.deleted&&c.kind!=='reply');const src=live[live.length-1];const el=document.querySelector('[data-card-id="'+src.id+'"]');el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',{bubbles:true,clientX:el.getBoundingClientRect().x+50,clientY:el.getBoundingClientRect().y+12,pointerId:23,buttons:1}));window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup',{bubbles:true,clientX:0,clientY:0,pointerId:23}));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600));const bottom=[...document.querySelectorAll("[data-im=\"connect-point\"]")].find(p=>p.getAttribute('data-side')==='bottom');const bb=bottom.getBoundingClientRect();const px=bb.left+bb.width/2,py=bb.top+bb.height/2;const before=(await (await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8896/api/interactive/boards/board_default/state')).json()).state.links.length;bottom.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',{bubbles:true,clientX:px,clientY:py,pointerId:24,buttons:1}));for(let i=1;i<=6;i++){window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove',{bubbles:true,clientX:px+i*40,clientY:py+300+i*20,pointerId:24,buttons:1}))}window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup',{bubbles:true,clientX:px+240,clientY:py+420,pointerId:24}));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500));const after=(await (await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8896/api/interactive/boards/board_default/state')).json()).state;return JSON.stringify({linksBefore:before,linksAfter:after.links.length,noLinkCreated:before===after.links.length})})()
